slides.notes:

slides.h: Ten years of building for real businesses.
slides.body: Small businesses, nonprofits and financial firms across the country — built and supported by one team, led by founder Adam Neuerburg.
stats: years building websites, CRMs and brands
slides.notes:
Ground the pitch in real work.
- 10+ years, 347+ projects, 139+ customers — say the numbers plainly, do not round up.
- Miliare Group and Virtuity: two websites plus the custom CRM tools thousands of financial agents use daily. Best proof that we build software, not just sites.
- Father's Advocacy Network: website plus a family-support platform. HB Beauty: premium medspa site plus ongoing SEO.
Q: Which of these feels closest to what you need?

slides.body: No layers of account managers. You work directly with the people designing and building your system.
steps: We learn how your business actually runs — your goals, your people and your bottlenecks.
A clear plan and a design that fits your brand, built around how your customers decide.
Websites, CRMs and automations delivered at startup speed, tested and ready to work.
SEO, marketing and support when you need it — on a monthly plan only if you want one.
slides.note: No lock-in contracts. You own the website, the CRM and the data — monthly help is optional, never required.
slides.notes:
Walk the four steps quickly; the point is: no mystery, direct line to the people building it.
- Discovery is where we map their real workflow — that is what makes the CRM fit.
- We can start small (website, or one workflow in the CRM) and add in phases.
- Ownership: they own what we build. Monthly plans exist, but are optional.
Q: Who on your team would be our main point of contact?

qs: How do clients submit tickets today?
How do you track response times against your SLAs?
How long do monthly client reports take?
Where does your device and warranty list live?
Which tools do you pay for monthly per technician?
What would you want on one screen every morning?
slides.notes:
Ask these out loud and type the answers into the lead’s discovery form in the Hub.
- Listen for the expensive manual step — that is the first automation to build.
- Listen for which tools they pay for monthly — that is the savings story.
